format: plain text, UTF-8, LF, one SLP1 word per line, Sanskrit alphabetical order (M->homorganic normalization)

consumers.use: detectors/slp1util.load_spellcheck_dict() — spell-check dictionary; detectors/spell_correct.py merges it into the trusted lexicon
headword spelling QA over the union/key1-key2 exports

novelty: Lifts the spell-check dictionary past the A55 union with the MWderivations key2 spellings the fifteen key1 exports miss (+13,883 words, 337,305 total), deduped on the exact SLP1 string and ordered with a raw-string tiebreak so a rerun is byte-identical — the union alone would have shipped 319,871 duplicate lines and a hash-seed-dependent order.
